event_properties.content: What do customers say about our packaging?

Packaging gets mentioned in **31 reviews** this month. 22 are positive — customers like the eco-friendly boxes. 9 are negative — mostly that the biryani container leaks during delivery. Worth flagging to your packaging vendor.
Are there any recurring complaints at my outlet?

Yes — at your **main outlet**, three complaints appear repeatedly: slow billing process (mentioned 11 times), inconsistent portion sizes (8 times), and the AC being too cold (6 times). These are actionable items your team can address quickly.
How am I doing on Google vs Zomato?

On **Google**, your average is 4.1 ★ with 234 reviews this month. On **Zomato**, 3.6 ★ with 189 reviews. The gap is mainly driven by delivery experience complaints on Zomato — dine-in customers (Google) tend to rate higher.
Which dish is getting the most praise?

The **Butter Chicken** is your most praised dish this month — mentioned positively in 67 reviews. Close second is **Garlic Naan** (52 mentions). Customers frequently pair these two in their positive comments.
Show me my average rating this month
Your average rating this month is **3.8 ★** across all platforms. Zomato: 3.9, Swiggy: 3.6, Google: 4.1. Compared to last month (3.7), you're up by 0.1 points overall.
What are customers complaining about the most?

Across all locations, the top complaints are: **1) Long wait times** (38% of negative feedback), **2) Cold food on delivery** (22%), and **3) Rude staff** (17%). Dine-in complaints spike on weekends, delivery complaints are consistent through the week.
